新增:
热门榜单
「热门」页显示近一天的热议话题、帖子榜与吧榜；帖子榜按浏览或点赞排行，吧榜可直接关注

话题页
话题有了单独的页面，显示简介、相关的吧与讨论帖；帖子中的 #话题# 可点按打开

无痕浏览
在「我」页开启后，看帖、逛吧和搜索都不留下记录，关闭应用后自动结束

搜索设置
在设置首页搜索设置项，打开后直接定位到该项

减弱动态效果
在「界面效果」中开启后，页面与图片以淡入淡出代替缩放；系统关闭动画时自动开启

网页下载与全屏
网页中的文件链接可下载，视频可全屏播放；长按图片或链接可查看、复制或分享
改进:
最近逛的吧
首页「经过贴吧」改为一行五个，下拉即可展开全部

浏览记录
按今天、昨天与更早分组，显示帖子所在的吧、图片与读到的楼层；可按标题、作者或吧名搜索

管理浏览记录
可多选删除，或清除最近一小时、今天的记录，清除前会先确认

记录按账号分开
浏览记录与搜索记录按账号分别保存

字体大小
可跟随系统字体大小，范围扩大到 80%–200%；字号较大时，顶栏、底栏与按钮的文字不会超出

刷新结果
刷新推荐后，在刷新处显示带来了几条新动态

网页浏览
顶栏显示网页标题与网站，并在其中显示加载进度；深色模式下网页随之变暗；无法打开时说明原因并可重新加载；向上滑动时顶栏让出空间

登录更顺畅
登录成功后直接完成，无需等待网页加载；各账号的网页登录互不影响

夜间看图
夜间模式下图片调暗程度减轻，打开大图时逐渐恢复亮度

吧内搜索
布局与首页搜索一致
修复: 添加账号时可能重复保存当前账号
登录失败后，已输入的内容丢失
打开帖子时未定位到对应的楼层或回复
切换回某个页面时意外刷新
吧内搜索结果未应用屏蔽规则
吧内搜索显示其他吧的搜索记录
楼中楼页的回复数固定在顶栏下，遮挡内容
读屏朗读浏览记录时读出分隔符号
看图时加载更多图片偶尔闪退
滑动页面时切换为液态玻璃材质偶尔闪退

New:
Trending charts
Trending shows the last day's hot topics, top threads and top forums; threads rank by views or likes, and forums can be followed from the list

Topic pages
Each topic has a page of its own with what it is about, its forums and its threads; tap a #topic# in a post to open it

Incognito
Turn it on from Me: no threads, forums or searches are recorded, and it ends when the app closes

Search settings
Search from the top of Settings and go straight to the setting

Reduce motion
Turn it on under Effects and pages and pictures fade instead of zooming; it is on whenever the system's animations are off

Downloads and full screen on the web
Download files that web pages link to and watch their videos full screen; hold a picture or link to view, copy or share it
Improved:
Recent forums
Recent forums on Home sit five to a row; pull down to open them all

History
Grouped into today, yesterday and earlier, with each thread's forum, picture and the floor you read to; search by title, author or forum

Managing history
Choose several entries to delete, or clear the last hour or today, each asking first

History by account
History and search history are kept for each account

Font size
Follow the system's text size, or choose from 80% to 200%; large text stays within bars and buttons

Refresh results
After refreshing For you, see how many new threads came where the loader was

Web pages
The bar shows the page's title and site and fills as it loads; pages darken in the dark appearance; a page that can't open says why and can be reloaded; the bar moves away as you scroll up

Smoother sign-in
Signing in finishes without waiting for the page to load, and each account's web login is kept apart

Pictures at night
Night mode dims pictures less, and they brighten as they open

Forum search
Laid out like the main search
Fixed: Adding an account could save the current one again
What was typed was lost when signing in failed
Threads didn't scroll to the floor or reply they were opened for
Some tabs refreshed when you came back to them
Block rules didn't apply to forum search results
Forum search showed other forums' search history
The reply count on the comments page stayed under the bar and covered the replies
Screen readers read out the dots in history entries
The picture viewer occasionally crashed as more pictures loaded
Switching to liquid glass while scrolling occasionally crashed the app
